temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with him; in response to his question, she says she is not upset with him, is dealing with personal stuff, and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believed Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's explanation indicates her curtness is not caused by anger at him but by personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress, and her short responses were not about him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially worried and concerned; after her reply, relieved and sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and supportive, perhaps offer help or a chance to talk, rather than trying to fix a misunderstanding.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break; Elizabeth accepts, says it is kind, and says a coffee break sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under personal stress and not upset with him; she may need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth is receptive to his support and agrees to spend time with him over coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: His offer of support is welcome; Elizabeth is willing to accept his company and may be open to talking.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathetic, caring, and pleased or gratified that she accepted.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Elizabeth through her stress, be available to talk, and follow through on the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; when Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is not sure and is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is stressed, receptive to his support, and he thinks professional help might benefit her; he worries about offending her by suggesting it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth has considered professional help but is hesitant or ambivalent; the suggestion was received without clear acceptance, and Keith remains concerned about overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth's stress is severe, and she is uncertain about seeking professional help; professional help may be beneficial, but she is not ready or comfortable.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and apprehensive about having offended her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her without pressuring her, suggest professional help carefully, and gauge whether she is open to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion. In response to Keith's apology, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He worried that suggesting professional help may have embarrassed or offended Elizabeth and that he had overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth explicitly says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern, though she is still processing the topic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He likely did not offend or overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern, but the issue is still heavy and she needs time to think.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful, then relieved or reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure Elizabeth of his support, avoid pushing the professional-help topic, and give her space while remaining available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth values his concern but is still processing personal stress; he hopes to maintain support without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support, feels better knowing he is there, and is more comfortable in their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship, remain available for chats or breaks, and continue respecting her boundaries.
